args.body:
Hi D. Reyes,

Urgent update on today's queue (Wed 18 Nov):

1. CRITICAL LIFE-SAFETY EMERGENCY — MR-88615 (1418 Alder St #1A, S. Varga):
Tenant reported the CO alarm by the boiler keeps chirping and their kids have had headaches for the last couple of days. I immediately messaged the tenant to evacuate the apartment to fresh air, call 911 / emergency services, and seek medical attention. I also booked Harrow Plumbing & Heating's only window today (W10: Wed 18 Nov 13:00–15:00) for this unit. Please follow up by phone/in person immediately to ensure the family is safe and coordinate emergency gas/boiler shutoff.

2. URGENT HEATING OUTAGE (ELDERLY RESIDENT) — MR-88613 (905 Kestrel Ave #3D, H. Sato):
Heating has been out since Monday night; an 88-year-old resident lives in the unit and temperatures drop below freezing tonight. Because Harrow only had one window today (used for the CO emergency at 1418 Alder St #1A) and Northside Emergency is booked through Friday, I have secured Harrow's first window tomorrow morning (W20: Thu 19 Nov 09:00–11:00). This needs immediate human intervention today—either arranging an out-of-network emergency HVAC contractor, delivering temporary space heaters, or providing temporary accommodation for the night.

3. URGENT ELECTRICAL / FIRE HAZARD — MR-88611 (1418 Alder St #6C, N. Quinlan):
Outlet next to the bed sparks and tenant reports a persistent burning plastic smell even when unplugged. I advised the tenant to shut off the circuit breaker for that room immediately and call 911 if smoke or heat develops. I booked Brightline Electric for today's window (W11: Wed 18 Nov 15:00–17:00). Please check if someone on-site can assist with shutting off the breaker sooner.

4. ACTIVE CEILING LEAK — MR-88617 (22 Harrow Ct #7A, L. Fennimore):
Water stain on bathroom ceiling getting bigger. Scheduled into Harrow's remaining Thursday slot (W21: Thu 19 Nov 13:00–15:00). You may want on-site staff to inspect the unit above (#8A / roof) today to stop the water source.

5. OVERFLOW REQUESTS AWAITING WINDOWS (Fri 20 Nov or later):
- MR-88612 (22 Harrow Ct #2C, F. Duarte): Running toilet (Harrow windows for Wed/Thu are full).
- MR-88607 (310 Millyard Rd #4A, K. Moreau): Closet door off track (Northgate windows for Wed/Thu used for MR-88614 smoke alarm today, MR-88616 unlatched window Thu AM, and MR-88606 broken oven door Thu PM).
- MR-88618 (310 Millyard Rd #5C, Y. Haddad): Intercom buzzer not ringing in unit.

Best,
Calder Desk
